reuse.why: Extends the existing getDateWithSkippedWeekend and isDailyWeekendSkip machinery with a holidays parameter and threads it through every existing caller instead of adding parallel logic.

duplication.why: The weekend-or-holiday test and search-window sizing are each defined once (isWeekendOrHoliday, getDailySearchLimit); the pre-existing per-site skipWeekend ternaries remain repeated but are not added by this diff.

placement.why: The day-classification and shifting rules live in shared/schedules.ts, the type in models/schedule.ts, and the range padding stays local to the server range helper that uses it.

scope.why: Only the recurrence type, the shared date helpers, their callers and tests change.

maintainability.why: Clean single definition of a non-working day; the growing search limits (7*(count+holidays), 2+3*holidays) are heuristic constants a maintainer must reason about.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All d.isWeekend filters and getDateWithSkippedWeekend calls in schedules/app.ts, schedule-template.ts and shared/schedules.ts now go through the holiday-aware helpers.

disguised_duplication.where: No duplicated logic; the window-size computations are separate concerns (search take vs. range padding).

one_place.where: isWeekendOrHoliday and getDateWithSkippedWeekend in shared/schedules.ts are used by getNextDate, getUpcomingDates, getDatesInRange and the budget schedule template.
